description: Object type attribute names equal under NFC name one attribute
notes: The spec says strings are equal when their NFC normalizations are, which would make the two names the same attribute named twice, an error for hashicorp/hcl (native/type-expressions/attribute-twice), while the native syntax doesn't normalize identifiers. hashicorp/hcl's getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) compares the names as written, finds no duplicate, and cty.ObjectWithOptionalAttrs merges the names under NFC into one attribute.
